procedure: Initialize repositories with separate random passwords and shared chunker parameters.
Back up 2 MiB random bytes; copy the selected snapshot.
Rename source repository, source password file and capture directory out of reach; restore without cache using only the secondary password; compare SHA-256.
Return source; forget and prune its snapshot; run copy again; restore retained secondary snapshot and compare SHA-256.
Back up 256 MiB new random bytes; start copy; SIGKILL after observing the first new destination pack file.
List secondary snapshots and restore the previous point; retry the interrupted copy.
Make source repository, password and capture unavailable again; restore the copied point and compare SHA-256.
Observe exclusive integrity check blocked by stale lock; verify killed process reaped with exit 137 and PID absent (ESRCH); unlock; run full data check.
Return source; remove its stale lock; repeat copy and verify identical secondary snapshot IDs.
